record.field:
I, the undersigned, hereby consent to the dental examination and treatment recommended by the dental practitioner. I understand the nature of the proposed treatment, associated risks, and available alternatives have been explained to me.

I consent to the administration of local anaesthesia and any other medications deemed necessary by the dentist. I understand that dental procedures may involve inherent risks including but not limited to: discomfort, infection, and nerve sensitivity.

I authorise the dental team to take necessary radiographs and clinical photographs for diagnostic and treatment planning purposes.

I consent to the extraction of the tooth/teeth as discussed with my dentist. I understand that complications may include: dry socket, infection, numbness, and jaw stiffness. Post-operative instructions have been explained to me.
